a0-01.title: My family photo
a0-01.story: Max, look at my [[photo]]. Six [[people]] are in it. This is my [[cousin]], Mila. This is my [[friend]] Lisa. This is [[Miss]] Green, my teacher. The [[baby]] has a funny [[face]]. It is my brother Taras!

a0-02.title: Fruit for lunch
a0-02.story: It is [[lunch]] time. Anna has [[rice]] and fish. Max wants [[lemonade]]. He likes [[lemon]] and [[lime]] in it. Anna has a yellow [[mango]]. Max has a green [[kiwi]]. Max wants Anna's fruit, too!

a0-03.title: A rainy day at home
a0-03.story: Taras is on the [[sofa]]. He has a red [[robot]]. Anna has a [[computer]] and a [[radio]]. Look at the [[poster]]! It is a big green [[monster]]! Taras has a [[camera]]. He wants a photo of it!

a0-04.title: Sport after class
a0-04.story: Max likes [[sport]]. [[Football|football]] is his [[hobby]]. Anna likes [[basketball]]. They want to play after [[class]]. Max has a ball. Oh no, it is a [[baseball]]! This ball is too small!

a0-05.title: Tennis and skateboards
a0-05.story: Lisa likes [[tennis]]. Ira likes [[badminton]]. Max has a [[hockey]] stick. Anna has a new [[skateboard]]. She likes [[skateboarding]] in the park. Look, Anna can jump! Good job, Anna!

a0-06.title: A day at the zoo
a0-06.story: The zoo is in a big [[park]]. Look at the [[tiger]]! The [[zebra]] is black and white. The [[crocodile]] has big teeth. Taras, look at the red [[helicopter]]! Dad has ice cream in the [[hall]].

a1-01.title: Nice to meet you
a1-01.story: Anna is a [[student]] at an English club. Her teacher, [[Mrs.]] Bell, has long red [[hair]]. "Find a [[partner]] and talk about their [[character]], [[please]]." Anna works with Sofia's [[boyfriend]], Leo. A man at the door drops his hat. Leo calls, "Hey, [[mister]], your hat!" Then he smiles: "Sorry, I mean, excuse me, [[sir]]!" The man laughs: "What a [[nice]] boy!"

a1-02.title: Lunch at the cafe
a1-02.story: Anna and Max are at a small [[cafe]]. There is [[pizza]], [[soup]], and a chicken [[sandwich]]. Max asks for a [[burger]]. "Sorry, we only have a [[hamburger]]," says the waiter. Max laughs: "It is the same thing!" Anna has [[yogurt]] with fruit and honey. Then they go to the juice [[bar]] next door. They buy milk for Mama at the [[supermarket]].
